We have to compare laptop quotations (RFQ-2026-014) and determine which vendor offers the fastest delivery. We have four vendors: Acme, BrightPath, Nimbus, Orbital. We need to extract delivery lead times.

From Acme: "Delivery lead time: 14 business days from purchase order".

BrightPath: "Delivery lead time: 21 calendar days from purchase order".

Nimbus: In the HTML: "Delivery 7 business days." So 7 business days.

Orbital: In CSV: "lead_time" column: "10 business days".

Thus fastest is Nimbus with 7 business days. We need to output: "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply" (vendor name). The user wants a line 'Fastest delivery: <vendor>'.

We should ensure we mention vendor name exactly as in the quote: "Nimbus Tech Supply". So final answer: "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply".

We also need to ensure we didn't miss any other vendor. The quotes list only those four. So answer accordingly.

We should not mention the bank details or emails. Just the final line.
